item.title: 💻 caskade: Building Pythonic Scientific Simulators
item.description: caskade is a Python library for constructing modular, differentiable scientific simulators with automatic parameter tracking and Bayesian inference integration.

item.title: 💻 Caustics: A Python Package for Accelerated Strong Gravitational Lensing Simulations
item.description: Caustics is a GPU-accelerated Python package for strong gravitational lensing forward modelling, enabling fast simulation and inference for large-scale lensing surveys.
